author: Pavell
content:
Not just the US, but all over the industrial world.
It doesn't pay to live within your financial limits anymore, this just keeps your head above water.
You have to live well below your financial limit. Put some cash into somewhere to live, doesn't have to be a stationary fixed residence, in fact it may have to be not a fixed residence, but somewhere and something that will be yours if and when the whole system does collapse.
One more thing, nothing is forever in this world, but in the next everything is forever, eternity, prepare for this now, because when you get there it will be too late to change, and we never know when we leave this world.
Jesus Christ promised He would return, and His return is immanent as King of this world as He already is of the next (eternity).
Find Him and you find your security.
